Cloud account

Family

Currencies

Entries in other currencies are converted to ₹ at the rate on the day of the transaction. Entries with no rate yet aren't in your totals: 0.

Loan documents

Import loan documents separately from normal bank statements.

Use this for a payment/amortization schedule, a lender account statement, a top-up/sanction letter, or a balance-transfer/takeover document. The document updates the loan structure; it does not create fake cash transactions from a forecast schedule.

Select all yearly documents together. They will be processed as one batch against an existing asset and its linked loan; you will confirm the loan details only once.

Historical & missing-month import

Import bank statements — any year

Pick one or many statements (PDF, CSV or Excel) from any year; every year in each file is imported. Entries already in the app from SMS or earlier imports are matched, never added twice.

Checking transaction coverage…
Select one or multiple PDF, CSV, XLS/XLSX or text statements. After import, this area shows files processed, rows read, new transactions, SMS matches, possible matches and skipped rows.

Data not from SMS

Checking for entries, bills and accounts that came from an earlier import rather than your phone's SMS…

Automatic backup

Keep a rotating backup of your processed ledger data, assets, loans and reconciliation history automatically on this phone. Original PDFs/XLS files are not stored in the processed backup; the backup contains the extracted loan data, document metadata, reconciliation and Ledger/asset links. The app keeps the latest 7 automatic backups.
